lessons.rule: AVOID: Spot distribution on volatile tokens (>10% daily move). RoyalPop-SOL loss — price dumped instantly out of range with spot strategy. Use bid_ask for anything showing >10% 24h volatility.
AVOID: Deploying when price is in bottom 30% of range. Position goes OOR immediately on any downward tick. Always verify active bin is between 30th-70th percentile of proposed range before deploying.

AVOID: RoyalPop-SOL type pools — high volatility + spot strategy = instant OOR on pump. Spot is only appropriate for low-volatility (<5% 24h) pairs. High-volatility tokens need bid_ask to capture fees across the price sweep.

PREFER: Bid-ask distribution when 24h volatility > 10%. Bid-ask concentrates liquidity at the active price and earns fees even as price sweeps — spot fills the entire range uniformly and goes OOR on any large move.
PREFER: Verify price is centered (30th-70th percentile of proposed bin range) before deploying. Centering ensures the position captures fees in both directions and is not already OOR at entry.
